name: Jing Hua Yi Qing - Mirage Sugar Acacia
original_name: 镜花饴情 Mirage Sugar Acacia
source:
The sweetness of sugary love is fleeting, and the romance between girls is as ethereal as flowers in a mirror. Stepping onto the freedom's stage of college campus, moving forward at a loss intertwining ideals and realities, can their fates fruit in the end? A sweet one-couple yuri story with multiple endings.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404110//]Steam[/url]]
translation:
糖一般甜蜜的爱意转瞬即逝，少女间的恋情如镜中花般缥缈。踏上自由的大学舞台，在理想与现实交织的迷惘中前行，她们的缘分最终能否开花结果？这是一部围绕一对恋人展开、拥有多个结局的甜蜜百合故事。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404110//]Steam[/url]]
